input_contract.notes: records is the peer's full-fidelity record set (the same set read_records() returns, wrapped-envelope shape per fixtures/memorysearch-real-record-envelope.reference.json). policy is the classifier + confidence-threshold config. Live Phase-4 integration decides the exact call-site inside the retrieval broker / thinking pre-prompt step; this fixture attaches at retrieval_broker.

output_contract.null_return: The entrypoint returns null when the classifier finds no record-content claim. On null the Pod proceeds normally and reconstruction remains legitimate for experiential/identity expression. A non-null packet is returned whenever a record-content claim is detected AND a real search executed — including the search_performed_no_verified_record case, which returns a packet (not null) so the no-verified-record prompt block is injected.

working_parameters.outside_parameters_behavior: On classifier=not-a-record-claim: return null, Pod proceeds unchanged. On Orb error or absence: Pod falls back to pre-Orb behavior (existing auto-retrieval only) and records orb_unavailable in T-Witness; the turn is never crashed. Provenance is runtime-authored only, so no fallback path can present model-authored citations or reconstruction as record-grounded.
